structured_output.riskNotes: The fix is a loop in src/app.js that calls randomSlug() again while store.has(slug) is true. store.has already existed. The check and the set run synchronously with no await between them, so two concurrent requests can't pick the same slug. If a custom randomSlug never returns a free slug, the loop never ends. The issue asks for exactly this behaviour, so I'm not treating it as a defect. The new tests force a collision, check that the original link is unchanged, and check that randomSlug is called once when there is no collision and not at all for an invalid URL.
